name: Intra Balance Movement Confirmation V 02
definition: The IntraBalanceMovementConfirmation message is sent from a settlement infrastructure to an account owner/requestor to confirm the movement of an amount of money within its holdings from one sub-balance to another. ||Usage: |The message may be used to: |- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is "Duplicate")|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is "Copy")|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is "CopyDuplicate").

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the message as known by the account servicer or settlement infrastructure.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account to or from which an entry is made.

CashAccountOwner.name: Cash Account Owner
CashAccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the cash account.

CashAccountServicer.name: Cash Account Servicer
CashAccountServicer.definition: Party that manages the cash account on behalf of the account owner, that is manages the registration and booking of entries on the account, calculates balances on the account and provides information about the account.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
